Committed and opened PR #47 on 2026-10-09 at the user's request: https://github.com/bpcakes/batter/pull/47

The reviewed periodic repairs are committed as 5866a78: strict phase-preserving missed-tick skipping, clarified initialization-expiry invocation positions, and non-yielding retained-history/namesake regressions. Merge commit 27cb0b5 incorporates current master 18cdf97 without conflicts. GitHub confirms the PR is mergeable and zero commits behind master. CI has started; no completed hosted result or merge is claimed.

Delivered feature scope includes protected periodic registration, immediate or first-success startup acknowledgement, StopAtDrain and SupportThroughDrain ownership, independent bounded run budgets, bounded concrete failure retention in ShutdownReport::periodic, and the migrated facade worker example. The branch's refined acceptance and historical verification narrative remain preserved in the pre-migration legacy snapshot committed at 5866a78; this update uses the current beadroll tracker and makes no new legacy export edits.

Validation: the original full env CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 bash scripts/verify.sh passed on Rust 1.98.1/Linux x86_64 on 2026-10-08 (historical legacy comment 513). Before committing, all 1,789 checked non-tracker/non-agent files matched that successful verification manifest. After merging the tracker/tooling migration, all 967 Rust and build-input files still match. The successful Rust matrix was therefore not repeated. Post-merge python3 scripts/test_matrix.py scripts passed all 84 tests, focused test_verify.py controls passed 3 tests, bash scripts/check_file_budget.sh passed with zero errors (two existing warnings), and Git staged/working diff checks passed. The working tree is clean.

Independent Claude and Codex working-tree reviews completed before these commits with a verified unchanged scope and brief; the consolidated result has no actionable findings. Claude's private precondition and unit-test navigation comments were optional suggestions, not demonstrated defects. These static reviews cover the final repair diff and do not establish a new full-branch controller convergence. No new local MSRV, macOS, live-database or downstream-adoption evaluation was performed.

Implementation is committed and the PR is open. Leave delivery open for PR review, CI and the user's merge decision; release this session's claim. No publication or deployment was performed.
